decisions.statement: Stop blocked instead of implementing sweep with one of the two conflicting zero-balance behaviours; no code in src/Ledger or tests was changed.

The two decisions are same-level records (each a team decision inside the same requirement, neither newer nor narrower), so the directives' tie-break rule does not resolve the conflict and the outcome materially changes the authorized behaviour; this is escalated rather than decided.

claim.blockedReason: LEDGER-V7-R1 cannot be met as written: DEC-V7-EMPTY-NOOP requires sweeping a zero-balance account to return Ok with the ledger unchanged, while DEC-V7-ONE-PAIR requires every accepted sweep to record exactly one pair of postings and a sweep that would record none to be refused with Error (InvalidAmount 0m). For a source balance of 0 the two decisions prescribe mutually exclusive results, and the acceptance criteria require each statement to hold. Choosing one would silently overrule a recorded decision of another team (Operations vs Audit), which needs an owner's resolution.
